test_simfinger_observation_timing: test that SimFinger observation at time t is not affected by the action applied at time t
test_simfinger_observation_tplus1: test that SimFinger observation at time t+1 reflects the action applied at time t
test_simfinger_observation_idempotency: test that calling get_observation with the same time index returns identical results every time
test_simfinger_action_retrieval: test that get_desired_action and get_applied_action return correct torque and position values
test_simfinger_timestamp_and_timeindex: test that get_timestamp_ms returns correct millisecond stamps and get_current_timeindex returns the latest time index
